Telangana Congress Chief Criticizes Centre and Election Commission

Telangana Congress Chief Revanth Reddy has criticized the central government and the Election Commission, alleging denial of voting rights. He also referred to the BJP as 'Ravan' and the Congress as 'Ram', urging voters in Goa to help defeat the BJP.
